en.longDescription:
Vikunja is an open-source to-do and project management tool with lists, Kanban, and team sharing.

Includes PostgreSQL. Set VIKUNJA_SERVICE_PUBLICURL via SERVICE_URL_VIKUNJA. Create your account on first launch; disable registration afterward with VIKUNJA_ENABLE_REGISTRATION=false.

de.longDescription:
Vikunja ist ein quelloffenes Tool für To-dos und Projektmanagement mit Listen, Kanban und Team-Sharing.

Enthält PostgreSQL. Setze VIKUNJA_SERVICE_PUBLICURL über SERVICE_URL_VIKUNJA. Konto beim ersten Start erstellen; Registrierung danach mit VIKUNJA_ENABLE_REGISTRATION=false deaktivieren.

fr.shortDescription: Gestion de tâches et de projets open source
fr.longDescription:
Vikunja est un outil open source de gestion de tâches et de projets avec listes, Kanban et partage d'équipe.

Inclut PostgreSQL. Définissez VIKUNJA_SERVICE_PUBLICURL via SERVICE_URL_VIKUNJA. Créez votre compte au premier lancement ; désactivez ensuite l'inscription avec VIKUNJA_ENABLE_REGISTRATION=false.

pt.shortDescription: Gestão de tarefas e projetos open source
pt.longDescription:
Vikunja é uma ferramenta open source de tarefas e gestão de projetos com listas, Kanban e partilha em equipa.

Inclui PostgreSQL. Defina VIKUNJA_SERVICE_PUBLICURL via SERVICE_URL_VIKUNJA. Crie a conta no primeiro arranque; desative o registo depois com VIKUNJA_ENABLE_REGISTRATION=false.
